recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,800.60 (+1.12%) and the Sensex at 83,919.71 (+1.08%); Bank Nifty moved +2.49%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +1.00%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +0.61%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.10%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹10,308 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹4,860 cr (provisional, NSE).
Bank led the sectors (+2.49%), while Media lagged (-1.68%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was IndusInd Bank (+8.59%); biggest faller was MTAR Technologies (-5.70%). Breadth: 250 advances vs 250 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 1.04% and the Nasdaq down 2.17%.
The rupee is at 92.66 per dollar, Brent at $88.15 (-4.16%) and gold at $3,549 (-3.71%).
